'''Remilok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]], working for people specializing in data security, he investigated the activities of [[Nova Blades]] pirates from the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Remilok appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
